Run a Unified Sensitivity Suite

Source: R/sensitivity-evidence-suite.R
run_sensitivity_suite.Rd

Orchestrates approved sensitivity components. Refitting components only run when explicitly requested in plan. Failures are retained as inspectable component results unless stop_on_error = TRUE.

Usage

run_sensitivity_suite(
  fit,
  plan = create_sensitivity_suite_plan(),
  reference_estimand = NULL,
  stop_on_error = FALSE
)

Arguments

fit

An approved gp3bayes fit.

plan

A create_sensitivity_suite_plan() result.

reference_estimand

Optional precomputed primary estimand. When alternatives are supplied and this is omitted it is computed with estimate_model_estimands().

stop_on_error

Whether the first component error should stop the suite.

Value

A gp3bayes_sensitivity_suite.
